panels.description:
This panel shows the real-time information of the condor queue. It also shows the compute resources requested by the job, when it was submitted to the queue, and when it started. 

Note:
1. *undefined => The respective data was unavailable because the job had not yet started or was on hold or idle.
2. Sometimes, request memory could be more than defined for the tool in the TPV tools.yml or the TPV shared database because we have a dedicated script that resubmits the job if it needs more memory up to a certain number of times.

options.content:
Compute group "Upload" is dedicated exclusively to integrating uploaded files into Galaxy as datasets.
At the moment, there are [no machines in the "upload" group](https://github.com/usegalaxy-eu/vgcn-infrastructure/commit/052e137a9b06238ea74167e6b38f673c0f11f721).

Upload jobs (`__DATA_FETCH__` tool identifier) are sent by [TPV](https://github.com/galaxyproject/total-perspective-vortex) to the
[`condor_upload` destination](https://github.com/usegalaxy-eu/infrastructure-playbook/blob/c6b1447bde8cd4fefc73a9f40c6382eadc450ff3/files/galaxy/tpv/destinations.yml.j2#L425-L436)
following [this rule](https://github.com/usegalaxy-eu/infrastructure-playbook/blob/c6b1447bde8cd4fefc73a9f40c6382eadc450ff3/files/galaxy/tpv/tools.yml#L14-L38). Note
that the destination settings imply upload jobs prefer machines from the "upload" group, but can also run in other groups.
